title: Coppola's One From The Heart Redux

commenti.body:
>aspect ratio changed to Academy format?

From what I can find, it's been 1.34/1 since at least the old Blu-Ray.

Would be very curious to see how much he changed about this movie. Up until now, I thought he had only removed 12 minutes. Didn't think that he possibly re-edited a bunch of the film.

But that makes sense. I think most of his recent recuts didn't consist of merely adding/removing scenes. Most of them involved quite a bit of tweaking.

The changes you mention sound good to me. I haven't seen this movie since the very old DVD, which I rented from Netflix maybe 10-15 years ago. I wouldn't be able to spot changes. But I really like his recent recuts and I'll be sure to buy this just to examine his editing technique.

Ah okay. The only time I'd seen the film before was when it streamed on Mubi a few years ago. It took me a little while to get through it and I don't remember noting the aspect ratio.

I enjoyed Apocalyse Now Redux very much (I saw it in a Dolby theatre) and have yet to revisit Godfather III: Coda.
